task.title: Receive Campus Security Alerts
task.shortdesc: Receive high-priority alerts by opting-in for campus security notifications..

context.p: You must consider opting-in for WolfAlert Messages to receive high-priority notifications from NC State through quick and concise text messages.

step.cmd: Sign into MyPack Portal with your Unity ID and Password.
Select the “For Students” tab. / Select the “Employee Self-Service” tab
Locate the Contact Information tab, then select Phone. / Select Phone Numbers.
Enter your cell phone number and area code, then select Save.
